questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how DeliveryTracker labels and records its delivery metrics? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
repo.save throws while marking an order delivered. What happens to the metrics?
choices: The duration is observed but the result counter is not incremented
Both metrics are recorded because they are computed before the save
Neither metric is recorded and the error propagates

questions.prompt: markDelivered is called twice for the same order, sequentially. What does the second call do?
choices: Records a second duration observation with a later deliveredAt
Throws because the loaded leg already has deliveredAt set
Overwrites deliveredAt and increments the counter only

questions.prompt: How many series does deliveryResults have at most for a single zone?
choices: Four: delivered plus the three failure reasons
